scenes.narration: Indigestion, also called dyspepsia, is impaired digestion. It causes discomfort and pain in the stomach. Signs are stomach pain, vomiting, gas, bloating and a burning feeling. If they do not go away, see your doctor right away.
Indigestion can be caused by overeating or eating too fast, lying down soon after meals, and eating spicy, oily and fatty foods.

Keep your digestive system happy. Eat a balanced diet. Eat clean, fresh, properly cooked food. Take green vegetables and fruits. Drink plenty of clean filtered water. Chew your food well, and eat at regular times.
